# Particulars of claim: authorities relied on

The claimant relies on the Limitation Act 1980, published at https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1980/58/section/5, and on the procedure rules at www.justice.gov.uk/courts/procedure-rules/civil.

Forms are available from https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/court-and-tribunal-forms, and fees are paid through the service at https://www.gov.uk/court-fees.

The decision in the earlier appeal is reported at https://www.bailii.org/ew/cases/EWCA/Civ/2023/12.html and summarised on https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/4321/. The European authorities are at https://eur-lex.europa.eu and https://hudoc.echr.coe.int.

Correspondence should be sent through the court's portal; no email address or telephone number is given in these particulars.

Claim value: £12,400. Section 5 applies to the contract claim; paragraph 7 sets out the interest calculation at 8 per cent.
